_evidence: 0x0041104f handles two car-record pointer globals, 0x0066d820 and 0x0066d82c (the second only when byte 0x007c2e6c != 0); each is null (or eax,eax / je - 0x409b87 stores 0) or a record of the 0x41c-stride array at 0x0066fef0 (0x409c13 searches it). For a non-null record without +0x8d bit 1 it toggles +0x71 bit 7 and updates +0xfe bit 2 and +0x230 bit 7 or +0x231 bit 5. Both pointers draw from null or records 0..5, so they are null, distinct or the same record (the second toggle then sees the first's write). The bytes +0x71 (0x0066ff61), +0x8d (0x0066ff7d), +0xfe (0x0066ffee), +0x230/+0x231 (0x00670120/1) of those records vary fully.
